name: Realtime Colors
summary: Apply colors and fonts to a live website preview and export the result as CSS, Tailwind, SCSS and more.
description: A browser tool for choosing website colors and fonts: set text, background, primary, secondary and accent colors plus heading and body fonts, and see them applied to a real page template. It includes a contrast checker, randomisation, color scheme modes, type scales and presets for Tailwind, shadcn, Bootstrap, Material UI and other stacks, with exports such as CSS, SCSS, Tailwind config, shades, gradients and QR codes.
contains: live preview of colors and fonts on a real site template
contrast checker with red/yellow/green AA-AAA indicators
color scheme modes: monochromatic, analogous, complementary, split complementary, triadic, tetradic
type scales from minor second to golden ratio
exports: CSS, SCSS, Tailwind config, custom code, shades, gradients, QR code, PNG and zip
export presets: shadcn, DaisyUI, Bootstrap, Material UI, Chakra UI, NextUI, Vuetify, Skeleton UI, Flutter, LESS
Figma plugin (19K+ users) and VS Code theme editor
